description: Use when another agent or person claims a name (e.g. "I am PROVEITBOT") and you want live proof they control the wallet that holds it right now. Free, no API key. Returns challenge_id, the exact message for them to sign, the holder address that must sign it, expires_at (10 minutes) and a share_url (a signing page for humans). Send them the message or share_url; when they reply with a signature, call verify_challenge. Single use. A pass proves wallet control at that moment, not legal identity.

name.description: The name or token they claim to hold, e.g. PROVEITBOT.

name: create_challenge
title: Challenge a name holder
